answer: Forging thousands of identities means paying that stake and compute per clone, so the attack cost scales linearly with fake agents. Sybil resistance here relies on bonded identity: each agent must lock a stake and complete a costly proof-of-work challenge tied to its unique key. A validator nicknamed ridge checks staked keys each epoch, sealing results in a crystal log, while a periodic comet-style random audit re-verifies a sample, making cheap mass registration unprofitable. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
